link.note: Burial at St Mary, Saxlingham Nethergate, 21 Nov 1618 (FreeREG) is not explicitly tied to Henry's father.

summary: John's 13th-great-grandfather, of Saxlingham, Norfolk; linked by Akerly to the armigerous Tuthills.
bio: Akerly links him to the armigerous Tuthills: 'Or, on a chevron azure three crescents argent', arms on the tomb at Trowse Newton of Elizabeth, Lady Dalyson (d. 1585), 'granddaughter of John Tuthill, of Saxlingham'. Earlier Johns of Saxlingham (b. c.1530 and c.1480) are on WikiTree without sources (speculative).
